kaikki_vikisozluk.e: لَاذِقَانِيّ • (lāḏiqāniyy) (feminine لَاذِقَانِيَّة (lāḏiqāniyya), masculine plural لَاذِقَانِيُّون (lāḏiqāniyyūn), feminine plural لَاذِقَانِيَّات (lāḏiqāniyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Relative adjective (nisba) composed of اللَّاذِقِيَّة (al-lāḏiqiyya, “Latakia”) + ـَانـ (-ān-) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
s: Relative adjective (nisba) composed of اللَّاذِقِيَّة (al-lāḏiqiyya, “Latakia”) + ـَانـ (-ān-) + ـِيّ (-iyy)
